title: Canonical ID Assignment
description: Gives every capability one canonical ID; duplicates collapse to it. Recorded facts — Rule: Canonical ID Assignment; Identifies: identity; Action: assign canonical. Used by network operators to keep capability directories clean and trustworthy.
demo:
# Canonical ID Assignment — runnable demo (python3)
# Canonical ID Assignment - dedup ratio (python3)
raw=1200
unique=1000
min_pct=10.0
saved=100.0*(raw-unique)/raw
print("duplicates removed: %d (%.1f%%)" % (raw-unique, saved))
print("DIRECTORY CLEAN" if saved >= min_pct else "LOW DUPLICATION")
